author: (Linnaeus, 1758)

note.en: A slender, indigo-blue open-ocean shark that is listed for Costa Rica but mostly lives in cooler, deeper offshore water; no local record, and not expected inshore.
note.es: Un tiburón delgado, azul índigo, de mar abierto, listado para Costa Rica pero que vive sobre todo en aguas más frías y profundas mar adentro; sin registros locales y no se espera cerca de la costa.

evidence: No local record found; FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic (coast not stated)

sources.t: IUCN Red List: Prionace glauca, Near Threatened

recWhy: Only a FishBase country listing; no local record, open-ocean species.

marks.en: Slender shark with deep indigo-blue back, white belly, very long curved pectoral fins and a long pointed snout.
marks.es: Tiburón esbelto con dorso azul índigo intenso, vientre blanco, aletas pectorales muy largas y curvas y hocico largo y puntiagudo.
